value.0: A throwing range is chalked onto the frozen floor, knife-scarred targets standing at the far end. The warden here throws at anyone who steps up.
A blast-test pad scorched black, ringed by frost-cracked safety markers. The warden who runs the detonation trials still keeps it armed.
A cluster of overloaded power cells is lashed to a test frame, humming dangerously in the cold. Its keeper is never far from it.
